inputs.name: hand over from Training Pipeline to Experiment Tracking

output.level_0: The Training Pipeline crashes when trying to log experiments.
output.level_1: No tracking happens when the Training Pipeline finishes.
output.level_2: A data scientist manually copies results from the Training Pipeline to Experiment Tracking.
output.level_3: The Training Pipeline automatically uploads metrics and artifacts to Experiment Tracking.
output.level_4: The Training Pipeline uploads metrics and artifacts to Experiment Tracking with audit logs and compliance checks.
